notes.title: Update 1.2.0
Update 1.1.10
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]The game has been transferred to a new engine version (some things should run faster, but there may be new bugs and crashes, we apologize in advance for any temporary inconvenience - we will try to find and fix everything asap).
[*]Text rendering in the game has been improved
[*]"Achievement failures" option has been added to the game settings, which allow to immediately inform the player if he fail "Cosmic Madness" (kill all enemies) or "Flawless Victory" (complete the game without taking damage) achievement.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
Update 1.0.6
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] "FPS limit" option added (Settings/Video)
[*] Global statistics for the “Flawless Victory” achievements have been reset (it was accidentally overincremented as a result of developer tests). If you have already unlocked this achievement, then simply open the game to synchronize its state with Steam.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.notes:
We hope that we have finally resolved the issue with XInput gamepads.
P.S. Special thanks to Alexander, who sent logs and helped localize the problem.
